card.name: West/northwest in place names
card.fires_on: The word west or western (also NW, Northwest) right after a place word like north, of, or a region name, in geographic names and directions.

modes.label: north + western
modes.description: The ending "western" after "north" in a region phrase.
modes.example: the wildfire caused evacuations across north<<western>> Wisconsin.

modes.label: West in institution or region name
modes.description: "of" or "West" inside names like University of the West of Scotland or Western Ontario.
modes.example: University of the West<< of>> Scotland.

modes.label: NW as address or region
modes.description: The abbreviation NW or Northwest in street addresses or regions.

card.plain: It spots the west or northwest part of a place name, as in northwestern Argentina or Western Ontario.
